steps.assistant_text: Retrospective verified source port onto frozen upstream. Independent native C, original USO identities, both raw modes, full ROM, six strict code-block payloads and no exact/raw/partial regression pass. Canonical and remote branches untouched.

analysis.purpose: Updates a bounded counter, clamps five channel values, and dispatches five mode-dependent HUD draws. Progressive reveal is likely, but the counter's precise gameplay meaning remains uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: Two 32-bit pointer arguments arrive in a0/a1 and are held in s0/s2. C reuses TimB5EntryFields and B5TimingScreen. Frame size is 0xB8. No explicit return-value construction is visible; the original return type remains unknown.

calls.observed_abi: Eight word arguments: entry pointer, entry+0xA4 value, entry+0xBC plus channel index times screen+0x74, descriptor pointer, signed clamped value, channel-region address, screen+0x230 address, screen pointer. First four use a0–a3; remaining four use outgoing stack slots 0x10–0x1C. Result ignored.
Same eight-word argument layout as 0xBD10. Selected when screen+0x3BC differs from 1. Result ignored.

evidence: Original per-site relocations retain two distinct known targets. Recovered callers=[] and unresolved_calls=[]; no verified game.uso DFS rank exists.
Function boundary is 0xBBDC–0xBDA0. Both C builds match the immutable 452-byte symbol, SHA256 fc715c54fb8e15ea351db27a24402349a38c6c2458b74daafb63c9e140d84417.
Observed signed entry fields: 0xA4, 0xBC, 0x1C4, 0x1DC, 0x1F4, 0x20C, 0x224, 0x2BC and 0x2C0. While 0x2BC<10, 0x2C0 decrements; a negative result resets it to 1 and increases 0x2BC by 2.
Screen fields include row stride 0x74 and mode 0x3BC. Forwarded regions begin at 0x134, 0x158, 0x17C, 0x1A0, 0x1C4 and 0x230. Descriptors advance by 0x18 from timproc_uso_b5_D_807FF4C0+0x40.

Inspected family: BBDC/C310 share counters and channel dispatch; BA60/C120 reset counters to 0/2; BB88/BBC8/B850/C044 corroborate the entry prefix through 0x2B8. Reused existing shared layouts. Callee source bodies 3A4C/3C8C use table-indexed sprite drawing and import_0024E608, import_0024F2C8, import_0024F34C and import_0024F75C.
A do/while loop with explicit caps cursor and indexed idxp[i] lets IDO generate the required cursor setup and increment ordering, resolving the former two-word mismatch.
